events.name: Wine & Cheese Pairing
events.description: Pull up a chair, neighbor. Our cheese guides pour four local-friendly wines and pair each with a hand-cut cheese — you bring the curiosity, we'll bring the twist.

events.name: Beer & Brats
events.description: Cold pours from the Beer Den meet sizzling brats off the grill. A laid-back evening of craft taps, good eats, and even better company.

events.name: Coffee Flights & Bites
events.description: Three roasts, three little bites, one bright morning. Sip your way through a guided coffee flight and find your new everyday cup.

events.name: Cake Decorating 101
events.description: Frosting tips, piping bags, and zero judgment. Our bakery team walks you through the basics — you'll leave with a cake you decorated (and maybe a new hobby).

events.name: Smokehouse Tapas & Taps
events.description: Low-and-slow smokehouse small plates paired with hand-picked taps. Pull up to the table and graze your way through the best of the Beer Den.

events.name: Tea Parties
events.store: Holly Springs, NC — 112 Bass Lake Road
events.description: A proper afternoon tea with a homegrown twist — loose-leaf brews, finger sandwiches, and sweets. Bring the little ones or just your best teacup.

events.name: Floral Arranging & Wine
events.description: Glass in one hand, garden shears in the other. Build a seasonal arrangement with our floral team while you sip — fresh blooms, fresh fun.

events.name: Cheer Box Pairing
events.description: Our curated Cheer Box, unboxed and paired bite-by-bite. A guided tasting of local snacks and treats worth gathering 'round the table for.

events.name: Wine & Cheese Pairing
events.description: Back by popular demand. Four pours, four cheeses, and the easy conversation that comes with them — all served with a twist of wit.

events.description: Start your Saturday the homegrown way. A guided flight of fresh roasts with sweet and savory bites to match each cup.
